title: Samsung Raises 2026 Chip Profit Outlook to Up to 370 Trillion Won on AI Memory Boom
detail: Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions semiconductor division told its labor union it could post operating profit of up to 370 trillion won ($274 billion) in 2026, 40 trillion won above the 330 trillion won guidance given at the division's June business briefing. The upgrade reflects stronger-than-expected AI semiconductor demand and a sharp run-up in DRAM and NAND flash prices — the fixed contract price for 64GB DDR5 server modules (RDIMM) reached $1,500 by mid-September, 5.5 times the $272 recorded a year earlier. Industry contacts said inventories at the three major memory makers had fallen to under 10 days, pointing to continued supply tightness. When performance-bonus costs are included, some estimates put the profit figure above 400 trillion won; the semiconductor division accounted for 97% of Samsung's total operating profit in the first half of 2026.

media.caption: Samsung Electronics raised its 2026 semiconductor division profit outlook to as much as 370 trillion won
